--value.name: --value

--expect.name: --expect

--expect-absent.name: --expect-absent
--expect-absent.description: Supply metadata and an exact compare-and-set expectation.

--param-file.description: Supply declared typed parameters from one chosen source.

--param-stdin.name: --param-stdin
--param-stdin.description: Supply declared typed parameters from one chosen source.

--execution-timeout-ms.name: --execution-timeout-ms
--execution-timeout-ms.description: Set invocation deadlines; omitted values are unlimited.

--package-name.description: Assign a local Package name on installation; does not silently rename an existing object.

--revision.description: Select an installed Revision by a unique package:revision reference.

--restore-from.name: --restore-from
--restore-from.description: Create the Instance, then restore this Snapshot. Failure can leave a created Instance; inspect the result.

--output.name: --output
--output.description: Write to a new file; existing destinations are not replaced.

--file.name: --file
--file.description: Read Input bytes from this file.

--stdin.name: --stdin
--stdin.description: Read Input bytes from standard input.

--instance.name: --instance
--instance.description: Filter by the selected live Instance.

--instance-id.name: --instance-id
--instance-id.description: Select retained history by exact Instance identity rather than its current name.

--no-retain-hook-text.name: --no-retain-hook-text
--no-retain-hook-text.description: Do not retain Hook free text; live output remains enabled.

--cancel-on-output-close.name: --cancel-on-output-close
--cancel-on-output-close.description: For JSONL execution only, request cancellation when the receiver closes stdout.

--view.name: --view
--view.description: Select the declared current, source or target binding view.

--copy-to.name: --copy-to
--copy-to.description: Copy the granted Input bytes into a new file.

migration-input-file.name: --input-file
migration-input-file.description: Supply a declared Input for a specific target Revision on the selected path.

hook-json-file.name: --file

input-output.name: --output
input-output.description: Write binding bytes to a new file, or use - for raw standard output.

bundle-output.name: --output
bundle-output.description: Publish a new bundle, appending the command's .pack or .snapshot suffix.
